title: Trust Document Update Backlog
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trust:document days_since_update=* document_status=*
| where days_since_update>730 AND document_status!="current"
| sort - days_since_update
| table document_type asset_value_usd days_since_update document_status
description: Surfaces trust documents not marked current and unchanged for more than two years.
value: Outdated trust schedules miss new accounts and property, creating probate gaps you thought you closed.
implementation: Log `days_since_update` and `document_status` for each trust document and review the backlog annually.
visualization: Table of stale trust documents by days since update.
grandmaExplanation: It counts trust paperwork that has not been updated in more than two years.
